summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Suryaa Oils store. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed covering health, products (list/filter/slug), OTP mock flow, admin login, /auth/me, addresses CRUD, orders (Razorpay mock + COD + totals with free-delivery @499 rule), admin orders/stats/status update, admin product CRUD, admin-only guards. Frontend: Homepage renders (hero+categories+bestsellers), Shop filters (4 products; coconut chip -> 1), ProductDetail variant/qty/add-to-cart works and cart drawer shows correct total (2x 1L @520 = ₹1,040 + free delivery), Login OTP flow succeeds and redirects to home, Admin login -> dashboard shows Revenue ₹849, Orders 2, Products 4, Customers 4 with Orders/Products tabs functional. One real bug detected in Checkout flow: race condition with CartContext hydration causes /checkout to redirect to /shop on direct navigation/refresh even when localStorage cart is non-empty.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: Checkout useEffect checks items.length===0 on first render and navigates to /shop BEFORE CartContext hydrates cart from localStorage. Users who refresh /checkout or navigate directly with a saved cart get kicked to /shop. Fix: wait for CartContext hydration flag (or defer redirect until localStorage load completes).

action_items: Fix CartContext hydration race in /app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.js — expose a `hydrated` boolean and guard the Checkout redirect in /app/frontend/src/pages/Checkout.js (only redirect to /shop when hydrated && items.length===0).
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext: items initialized to [] then hydrated from localStorage in useEffect -> causes redirect race in Checkout. Recommend initializing state via a lazy initializer: useState(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]')).
server.py: order verify signature check in mock mode always returns ok=True (expected in mock, but ensure production RAZORPAY_MODE gate is clear). OK for now.
server.py verify_otp accepts either stored code OR mock code — acceptable in mock mode, but ensure OTP_MODE='live' gates OTP_MOCK_CODE properly (it does).
Admin dashboard: consider adding data-testid=stat-* on the 4 stat tiles for future automation (visible values render correctly).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@yourstore.com / Admin@123. User: any 10-digit mobile + OTP 123456. Written to /app/memory/test_credentials.md? No — file was empty; recommend main agent populates.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 4 products (2 groundnut, 1 coconut, 1 almond). Tests created a couple of orders and 1 TEST admin product (deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (23 tests, pytest -n auto). Only known issue: Checkout page redirects to /shop on direct nav due to cart hydration race. Everything else — auth, cart drawer, admin dashboard, product CRUD, order flows — verified working via UI and API.
rca of the issue: Checkout /shop redirect: CartProvider sets items=[] initially, then hydrates from localStorage via useEffect. Checkout page mounts, its own useEffect sees items.length===0 synchronously and calls nav('/shop'). Fix by either (a) lazy-init items from localStorage in useState, or (b) add a hydrated flag and skip the redirect until hydrated==true.
